clusters.mechanism: limitless_status schema strips run.merged and the landed check ignores it, so confirmed-merged runs are reported as unknown or needing review instead of Landed.

Digest only seeds review candidates from opening, round-delivery and approval events, so unread later PR events (e.g. pr.ci_passed) after an acknowledged approval never trigger reconciliation of a stale approval.
Digest awaiting-review predicate ignores review.rounds, so PRs with a queued or running changes round are listed as awaiting review.
The blocked-land branch in explainStatus precedes the CLOSED PR check, so closed PRs get advice to retry landing.
When the privacy policy is unreadable, the MCP handler runs mutating tools and then replaces their results with a generic withheld message, losing run ids and receipts.
With no privacy policy, limitless_status returns only land and openQuestions, dropping the state and nextAction fields.
Digest quote() does not escape bidi and zero-width characters in untrusted PR titles.
An approved PR with no saved snapshot is counted as awaiting review because approval.sha differs from undefined headRefOid.
The publication gate decoder was changed to decode \uXXXX escapes, which is out of scope and pushes the diff over the line budget.
Digest lists PRs as awaiting review while their run is still in progress, because it does not require the run to be finished.
GET /api/land for an unknown run returns 400 instead of 404 because a plain Error is mapped to 400.
The Codex skill is a copy of the Claude skill and tells Codex to use the claude consumer name.
limitless_review and limitless_land return the raw backend response without zod schema validation.
